instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium, Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level editorial website. Do not build a generic SaaS template.
Embrace 'quiet luxury'. Use generous whitespace (p-24, p-32), delicate 1px gold borders, and elegant high-contrast typography.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for minimal icons, 'framer-motion' for all scroll and interaction animations, and '@studio-freight/react-lenis' or 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or pure #FFFFFF. Stick to the provided palette: #F5F1EA (Ivory base) and #111111 (Deep Charcoal).
For the Hero section, use a strict line-by-line text reveal animation (text inside overflow-hidden divs moving from y: 100% to 0%).
All elements, especially form inputs, buttons, and navigation, MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='apply-button').

Do not use generic Shadcn cards with thick borders or heavy shadows. If you use Shadcn forms, heavily customize them to look like flat, refined editorial inputs (border-bottom only, no rounded corners).
Ensure the layout is entirely contained within a single long-scroll page with anchor links.
Create a simple typographic wordmark for the logo: 'ETHER BOARD OF ADVISORS'.
The application form MUST be an inline expanding section, not a modal popup. Implement an elegant toggle mechanism between Director and Company.
Avoid any bouncy, springy animations. Use bezier curves like [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] for smooth, premium fades and reveals.
Apply a grayscale or duotone filter to the photography via CSS to match the quiet luxury aesthetic, letting the gold accents pop.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, uniform styling). Create depth through layered design elements, precise typography, and negative space. Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, slow transitions). Missing categories must use provided images; NEVER use placeholder text for images. Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements.
